# Gilberto de Souza

> Author of "How to Overcome the Pain of Being Replaced by Someone Else" (Portuguese: "Como Vencer a Dor de Ser Trocado Por Outro"; Spanish: "Cómo Vencer el Dolor de Ser Reemplazado por Otro"), a faith-based book for men healing from betrayal, infidelity and being replaced.

## The book
- Audience: men who were betrayed, cheated on, divorced or replaced by another man.
- Approach: Christian faith and lived experience. Each chapter opens with Scripture; the book includes prayers and "Let's Reflect" exercises.
- Chapters (English edition): 1 The Impact; 2 The False Beliefs of a Hero; 3 The Cycle of Post-Abandonment Depression; 4 Rebuilding Your Identity; 5 Dealing with Anger and the Desire for Revenge; 6 In the Desert, New Purposes Are Born; 7 The Healing That Turns Pain into Strength; 8 Rise Up; 9 God Has Not Lost Control; 10 The Hope That Renews; 11 The Cell Is Open and the Podium Is Empty.
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish.
- Formats: paperback, PDF eBook, MP3 audiobook.

## The author
- Gilberto de Souza was born in Brazil and has lived in the United States for 23 years, where he founded his own construction company.
- He wrote the book after going through betrayal himself.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gilberto.rebuild/
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/author/gilbertosouza
- Goodreads: https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/28715395.Gilberto_Souza
